info.title: Inventory Management API
info.description: API Spec được sinh tự động - Inventory Management System

bearerAuth.name: Authorization
bearerAuth.description: JWT Bearer token via cookie `session` or header `Authorization: Bearer <token>`

post.description: Authenticate user, set httpOnly session cookie and return JWT token
Clears session cookie and user cache

post.summary: Create sales order (auto-creates invoice if not import)
Create invoice from order lines (partial allowed)
Return part or all of a sale order
Import products from xlsx/csv (create + update by skuCode)
Unified product query for POS/Sell and Admin (exact scan match + context fallback)

put.summary: Update a product (simple + variant unified; variants carry their own barcode)

delete.summary: Soft-delete a product + its variants (paranoid; keeps orders/stock/finance)

get.summary: List barcode selling units for a product

delete.summary: Soft-delete a single variant (paranoid; keeps orders/stock history)

post.summary: Restore a soft-deleted product + its variants
Transfer stock between warehouses (items: [{productId, variantId?, quantity}])

delete.summary: Soft-delete a non-main warehouse with no inventory or unfinished orders

get.summary: Get stock history by product ID

patch.summary: Update vendor settings by id (must match the active workspace vendor)

post.summary: Start (open) a stocktake session for a warehouse
Complete session: apply variances to inventory
